fields.label: Your calendars
fields.help: One link per calendar, like Family|https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/.../basic.ics. Google hands that link out under Settings, then "Secret address in iCal format"; Outlook, Apple and Nextcloud have their own. The name before the | is what shows next to an appointment; without one the calendar's own name is used.

fields.label: Days in the week
fields.help: How many days "calendars week" looks ahead. Seven by default.
